text_markup: {n}Tag counters and bad publicity counters{/n} have no specific location in the play area {n}unless hosted on a card{/n}. Other types of counters are either nonfunctional gameplay aids or appear only in host relationships. See also {ref:sec_counters_and_tokens}.
text_plain: Tag counters and bad publicity counters have no specific location in the play area unless hosted on a card. Other types of counters are either nonfunctional gameplay aids or appear only in host relationships. See also section 1.9.
